field.label: Enabled
field.comment: No stops sitemap generation for this scope (cron, Generate Now and the command line), removes the sitemap files of its profiles when the configuration is saved, drops the Sitemap line from robots.txt and llms.txt, and hides the Include in XML Sitemap toggle on product and category edit forms.

field.label: Homepage Optimization
field.comment: When enabled, the store home page is added as the first entry of the products sitemap, with the profile's Homepage Priority (default 1.0) and the product change frequency (daily when none is set).

field.label: Sitemap Index Filename
field.comment: Index filename for the store-based build (bin/magento panth:seo:sitemap:generate when no profile is active) and for profiles saved before 1.2.8 that have no Sitemap Filename yet. Each profile sets its own Sitemap Filename. Default sitemap.xml. A name that does not end in .xml or contains characters other than letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore falls back to sitemap.xml.

field.label: URLs per Shard
field.comment: Maximum number of URLs per sitemap file before creating a new shard. Google allows up to 50,000 URLs per file. Recommended: 45,000.

field.label: Gzip Output
field.comment: When Yes, every sitemap file listed in the index is written as a gzip file (sitemap-products-1.xml.gz and so on) and the index links to the .gz names. The index file itself stays plain XML at the same URL. Default: No, which writes plain .xml files as before.

field.label: Write Change Frequency and Priority
field.comment: Writes the changefreq and priority values set on profiles and in Additional Links into each url entry. Google ignores both elements; set to No to leave them out. Default: Yes.

field.label: Enable XSL Stylesheet
field.comment: Adds an XSL stylesheet reference to the XML sitemap for human-readable rendering in web browsers.

field.label: Exclude Out-of-Stock Products
field.comment: Omits products whose stock status is Out of Stock. Used by the store-based build when no profile is active; profiles use their own setting.

field.label: Exclude NOINDEX Pages
field.comment: Omits pages marked as noindex from the XML sitemap to keep it consistent with robots directives.

field.label: Include Hreflang Alternates
field.comment: Adds xhtml:link hreflang alternate entries for product, category and CMS page URLs in the store-based build when no profile is active. Profiles use their own Include Hreflang Tags setting. Alternates come from the hreflang resolver, see Use Panth Hreflang Module.

field.label: Use Panth Hreflang Module
field.comment: When Yes and mage2kishan/module-hreflang is installed, hreflang alternates are read from that module. Adds one lookup per product, category and CMS URL, so builds of large catalogs take longer. Default: No, which writes no hreflang alternates.

field.label: Include Image Extension
field.comment: Adds image:image entries to product URLs in the sitemap for Google Image Search indexing.

field.label: Product Image Source for Sitemap
field.comment: Which product image role to use in image sitemap entries.

field.label: Include Video Extension
field.comment: Include video sitemap entries for products with external video media gallery items.

field.label: Additional Links (one URL per line)
field.comment: Extra URLs to include in the sitemap that are not auto-discovered (e.g. external landing pages or custom routes).
